## JustMic 1.3.2

- Fixed HEAR ME appearing enabled while privacy protection kept live voice silent. Enabling it now asks you to accept the capture risk, then plays on your selected headphones.
- Removed automatic switching to Chat/Secondary outputs. Your selected headphone device is respected, with a fallback only if it disappears.
- Added PAUSE FOR SHARING beside HEAR ME. It pauses live voice playback without changing your JustMic microphone, effects, soundboard routes or levels; releasing it preserves your previous monitoring intent.
- Sharing pause is manual: JustMic cannot reliably detect screen sharing in every app. Enable it before sharing or recording. Software monitoring can be captured even when Discord's microphone is muted.
- Settings, presets, sound copies and startup preferences are preserved. Updates do not silently enable voice monitoring.
